pii_notes.note: Primary identifier; retained but flagged as PII.

key_decisions: Used provided Attrition_Flag as primary churn source and created binary churn column (churn=1 for 'Attrited Customer').
Derived monthly_spend, avg_txn_value, tenure_months, and spend_quintile for segmentation and analysis.
assumptions: No date/last_active fields present; therefore churn is taken from Attrition_Flag as authoritative. If a time-based churn definition is required, transaction timestamps or last_active_date must be provided. Retained all rows except those missing CLIENTNUM (none). Conservatively imputed modeling features with median for logistic/DT training only; no imputation applied to canonical cleaned.csv.
